description: Retrieves a paginated list of published component sets (collections of reusable UI elements) from a specified Figma team's library.

after.description: Cursor for pagination, indicating the point after which to retrieve component sets. Exclusive with the 'before' parameter. The cursor value is an internally tracked integer and does not correspond to any specific Figma IDs.
after.title: After

before.description: Cursor for pagination, indicating the point before which to retrieve component sets. Exclusive with the 'after' parameter. The cursor value is an internally tracked integer and does not correspond to any specific Figma IDs.
before.title: Before

page_size.description: Number of component sets to return in a single page.
page_size.title: Page Size

team_id.description: The unique identifier of the Figma team from which to list component sets. IMPORTANT: Team IDs cannot be obtained programmatically via the Figma API. To find your team_id: navigate to your team page in the Figma web app (https://www.figma.com/files/team/YOUR_TEAM_ID/Team-Name), the team_id is the numeric string after '/team/' in the URL.
team_id.title: Team Id

name: get_team_component_sets

containing_frame.description: Optional. Information about the frame that contains a component from this set, providing contextual placement data.
containing_frame.title: Containing Frame

created_at.description: The date and time (UTC ISO 8601 format) when the component set was initially created.
created_at.title: Created At

description.description: A textual description of the component set, as provided by its publisher.
description.title: Description

file_key.description: The unique key of the Figma file that contains this component set.
file_key.title: File Key

key.description: The unique key acting as an identifier for the component set.
key.title: Key

name.description: The human-readable name of the component set.
name.title: Name

node_id.description: The unique identifier of the component set's node within the Figma file structure.
node_id.title: Node Id

thumbnail_url.description: Optional. URL for a thumbnail image preview of the component set.
thumbnail_url.title: Thumbnail Url

updated_at.description: The date and time (UTC ISO 8601 format) when the component set was last modified.
updated_at.title: Updated At

user.description: Information about the user associated with (e.g., creator of) the component set.
user.title: User

name.description: Optional. The name assigned to the component set node.
name.title: Name

nodeId.description: Optional. The unique identifier of the component set node.
nodeId.title: Node Id

backgroundColor.description: Optional. The background color of the frame, typically in a hex string format (e.g., '#FFFFFF').
backgroundColor.title: Background Color

containingComponentSet.description: Optional. Details of the component set node that contains this frame, if applicable.
containingComponentSet.title: Containing Component Set

containingStateGroup.description: Deprecated - Use `containingComponentSet` instead for more accurate information.
containingStateGroup.title: Containing State Group

name.description: Optional. The name of the frame node.
name.title: Name

nodeId.description: Optional. The unique identifier of the frame node within the Figma file.
nodeId.title: Node Id

pageId.description: The unique identifier of the page that contains this frame node.
pageId.title: Page Id

pageName.description: The name of the page that contains this frame node.
pageName.title: Page Name

name.description: Optional. The name assigned to the state group node.
name.title: Name

nodeId.description: Optional. The unique identifier of the state group node.
nodeId.title: Node Id

after.description: Optional. Cursor for paginating to the next page of results. The cursor value is an internally tracked integer.
after.title: After

before.description: Optional. Cursor for paginating to the previous page of results. The cursor value is an internally tracked integer.
before.title: Before

data.description: The structured response from the API, containing the status, error indicator, and the metadata which includes component sets and pagination cursors.
data.title: Data

component_sets.description: A list of `ComponentSet` objects detailing the retrieved component sets.
component_sets.title: Component Sets

cursor.description: Pagination cursors. Contains `before` and `after` cursors for navigating through the list of component sets. These are internally tracked integers.
cursor.title: Cursor

error.description: Indicates if an error occurred with the request. For successful requests, this value is always `false`.
error.title: Error

meta.description: The main data payload of the response, including the list of component sets (`component_sets`) and pagination cursors (`cursor`).
meta.title: Meta

status.description: The HTTP status code of the response. A value of 200 typically indicates success.
status.title: Status

handle.description: The user's display name or handle.
handle.title: Handle

id.description: Unique and stable identifier for the user.
id.title: Id

img_url.description: URL pointing to the user's profile image.
img_url.title: Img Url
